assets.prompt: Asset type: an original transparent 2D brand wordmark sprite for the real Unity menu of Rising Steps. The referenced image is only style and brand reference, especially its first menu panel; do not recreate its background or UI. Create a single tightly framed forest-green wordmark with a small flat silhouette emblem above it: an ancient arch/temple on an irregular floating island hill with a tiny rising path. Below, exactly two lines of very bold elegant adventure serif letters: RISING on the first line, STEPS on the second. Thick sculpted classic serif stems, dignified warm storybook expedition identity, strong readable letters, softly rounded carved terminal details, closely matching the heavy dark-green logo in the reference. Flat monochrome deep teal-green (#143f39), with only a fine muted antiqued-gold dividing ornament below the words, no painted lighting, no 3D background, no banner, no characters, no flowers, no clouds. Centered composition with tiny transparent margins. All outside pixels transparent with clean alpha edges. Text exactly: RISING STEPS. This is a standalone Unity UI logo asset; not a mockup, screenshot, illustration scene or whole concept board.
